question: Can the frozen same-side 12H FVG tag condition whether the unfilled two-thirds 2R limit expires after 12 hours, while preserving the high-growth OKX hourly 20% single-name-cap account?
single_variable: Only the cancellation rule for the unfilled 2R partial changes. Primary: FVG `outside` keeps the fixed 12h expiry; FVG `overlap` leaves the original resting 2R order active until the native runner exits. Reciprocal mapping is also preregistered as a non-selecting diagnostic.
candidate_paths: Use native OKX V1.7 runner/two-thirds-2R paths from cloud_close_thirds.okx_paths(). At admission, the primary target policy chooses the existing native 2R path if filled before its 12h expiry; otherwise it chooses the already-frozen full-runner path. Persistent arms retain the native 2R path through its actual target fill or native runner exit.
fvg_source: experiments/active/exp-cloud-close-fvg-exclusion-20261109-v1/decisions.csv.gz. Join by the original 1-based source_row_number; verify symbol/week against the frozen signal input. Never recompute or retag the FVG observations.
coverage: All arms use the same known V1.7 opportunity set classified `outside` or `overlap`; unknown labels (including warmup/opened-beyond-line and any missing coverage) are excluded from every arm before VectorBT admission. Matched later controls inherit the parent source_row_number and its frozen FVG label, matching the existing FVG exclusion semantics.
policies: always_expire_12h: fixed existing 12h cancellation on the known subset
always_persist_2r: keep the original 2R limit through the native runner exit on the known subset
account: OKX only; initial cash 1000 USDT; 9 cash-sharing slots at NAV/9; original 2/3 resting 2R partial and 1/3 cloud runner; the prior frozen hourly VectorBT manager caps marked single-symbol notional at 20% of prior-close NAV at each completed UTC H1 close. Preserve original order priority, exits, fee class and 5bp taker/2bp resting maker costs.
evaluation: Report funded count, terminal account value, equal-notional and realized-cash win/payoff, marked and conservative hourly drawdown, and all/dev (through 2024)/2025/2026 metrics. Always-expire and always-persist are rerun on the identical known candidate set; the unfiltered 68115U hourly account is context only, not an equal-coverage control.
sensitivity_gate: Run paired matched-later-control and +5bp per taker fill sensitivity only if the primary arm meets the existing win/payoff/dd/trade gates in development and full history and its development and full terminal wealth both exceed both fixed known-coverage controls. Never lower the gate or select the reciprocal arm.
execution: VectorBT cash-sharing account; reuse cloud_close_hourly_trim's 1h 20% cap callback for zero-slippage arms. A local callback wrapper applies +5bp slippage to every taker fill, including hourly cap trims, only for the gated stress arm.
costs_and_limits: Maker 2bp per resting fill, taker 5bp per market/stop fill, optional additional 5bp market impact for the gated stress. No funding, exchange lot/tick rounding, queue position, or order-book capacity. Research only.
